# Manual Commands

Every command the `manual` module offers, from its declarations, in order of the resource each acts on. Each command's help says the same.

## Aliases

A group's alias is a word a person may type in place of its own, declared in the module's `[aliases]`. `lnk manual` is typed short as `lnk man`.

## `lnk manual show`

Read Link documentation offline. Without a path, show the front page and topic index.

```usage
lnk manual show [path] [--command <command>] [--commands] [--variables]
```

- `--command`, string: Read one command reference, such as box create
- `--commands`, boolean: List the topic's commands
- `path`, position 1, string: A canonical documentation path, such as agents/start
- `--variables`, boolean: List the topic's environment variables

It answers `manual.page`.
